names.why: Company-confirmed: Nike's 2026-08-28 press release (Business Wire URL dated 20260828) sets Q1 FY27 results for Thu 2026-10-01 around 1:15pm PT, after the close, so the calendar row is right; caveat: the baseline's 2026-06-23 row (-1.32%) is not an earnings print (Q4 FY26 came out 2026-06-30), so read the history as 7 real prints, not 8.
names.session_evidence: Company release: results 'at approximately 1:15 p.m. PT, following the close of regular stock market trading hours', call at 2:00 p.m. PT, so this is amc https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260828161061/en/NIKE-Inc.-Announces-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027-Earnings-and-Conference-Call
where_to_look: Greater China sell-through: Q3 guided China down about 20% and Q4 China came in -12%. Look for evidence of the Q1/Q2 China trajectory in Anta/Li Ning/Pop Mart-adjacent data, Tmall/JD Singles-Day pre-sale and 618 rankings, and Topsports (6110.HK) quarterly retail operating updates, which disclose Nike-heavy China retail sales
Wholesale partners' reported quarters covering Jun-Aug: Foot Locker/Dick's (DKS), JD Sports trading updates, and Academy/Hibbett commentary on Nike sell-through and full-price inventory

Tariff line: whether the $986m IEEPA refund recognised in Q4 (and how much of the 900bp gross margin was one-off) has been received or contested. Check court and CBP refund status filings, plus any 10-K language on recovery timing (10-K filed July 2026 on EDGAR CIK 320187)

Q2 / holiday guide components: the stock has traded on the forward guide (see trades_on). Look for read-across from peers' guides (Adidas Q2 commentary, On, Deckers/HOKA, Lululemon Sept print) on the US promotional environment heading into holiday

Positioning: record 87M shares short and the short percentage of float more than doubling makes the crowding itself a candidate. Check the FINRA mid-September settlement versus end of August and the put/call open interest at the 2026-10-02 expiry
already_in_the_wire: Q1 FY27 date and time (press release 2026-08-28)
Q4 FY26: revenue $11.0B (-1% reported, -4% currency-neutral), EPS $0.72 including a $0.52 IEEPA refund benefit (about $0.20 ex-refund), Greater China -12%
Management said gross margin expansion begins in Q1 FY27, earlier than planned; the Q1 outlook assumes 10% incremental tariffs through July and 15% after
Q3 FY26 guide cut (Q4 sales -2 to -4% against consensus +1.9%; China about -20%), sent the stock to a 12-year low
Stock about 52% below its 52-week high and 1.5% above its 52-week low; consensus EPS $0.43 against $0.49 a year ago (Nasdaq calendar)
Straddle prices about a 9.2% move, with downside skew paid (baseline)
Record short interest, already written up by Yahoo/Benzinga ahead of the print
names.trades_on: The forward guide, not the reported quarter. Q3 FY26 beat on EPS and revenue but fell about 9% after hours and -15.5% close-to-close on a Q4 sales guide of -2 to -4% and China -20% (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/31/nike-nke-earnings-q3-2026.html). Q4 FY26 topped estimates, fell as much as 8% after hours on the cautious Q1 outlook, then recovered to +4.9% on the margin-expansion timing (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/30/nike-nke-q4-2026-earnings.html).
names.short_interest: About 7.28% of float, short ratio about 2.93 days, record ~87M shares short (snippet_only; Yahoo Finance / stockanalysis, data as of late September 2026, settlement date not verified) https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nke-ticks-higher-ahead-q1-080734899.html ; https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nke/statistics/
